name: eki-ecosystem
description: University bus tracking with authenticated HTTPS GNSS telemetry, resilient ordered trip state, and a Next.js frontend.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs && node scripts/update-csp.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build:production && npx firebase deploy
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev --omit=optional
